mapper.sql: p.*, u.nickname AS create_by_name, COALESCE(a.total, 0) AS total, COALESCE(a.done_count, 0) AS done_count

FROM hr_perf_plan p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.create_by LEFT JOIN (SELECT plan_id, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done_count FROM hr_perf_appraisal GROUP BY plan_id) a ON a.plan_id = p.id
